title: Mini UVM FIFO Environment Capstone
description: Build a complete single-agent UVM environment for a FIFO: sequences, driver and monitor through clocking blocks, an active agent, an analysis-FIFO scoreboard with check_phase accounting, a coverage subscriber and a factory override, then prove it catches an injected bug.

steps.title: Step 1: Complete the Sequences and the Active Agent
steps.instructions: `fifo_txn`, `fifo_sequencer` and `fifo_if` are complete; read the skew comments on `monitor_cb` first. In `testbench.sv`, fill in `send_write`, `send_read` and both sequence bodies; the driver's drive loop through `driver_cb`; the monitor through `monitor_cb`, creating a new `fifo_txn` per requested operation; and the agent's build and connect, including promoting `monitor.ap` to the agent's `ap`.

steps.title: Step 2: Wire Checking, Accounting and Coverage
steps.instructions: Connect the scoreboard's `observed_export` to its analysis FIFO, and in the env connect `agent.ap` to `scoreboard.observed_export` and `coverage.analysis_export`. Write the reference-queue checks, the `check_phase` errors for leftovers (`SCB_PENDING`) and for a run that checked nothing (`SCB_NO_TRAFFIC`), the `SCB_SUMMARY` line, and the coverage bins with their `COV_SUMMARY` report.

steps.title: Step 3: Exercise the Factory Override and End the Test Cleanly
steps.instructions: In the test, override `fifo_base_seq` with `fifo_capstone_seq`, raise an objection before anything consumes time, set a 10ns drain time on the phase's objection, create `fifo_base_seq` through the factory, print its type name, start it on `env.agent.sequencer`, and drop the objection. The log must show `fifo_capstone_seq`.

steps.title: Step 4: Prove the Bug, Then the Clean Run
steps.instructions: Run `testbench.sv` once with `+define+INJECT_FIFO_BUG`: expect exactly one `SCB_MISMATCH` (expected 0xa5, observed 0x5a), `SCB_SUMMARY matches=6 mismatches=1 pending=0` and no `MISSED_BUG`. Then run without the define: expect `SCB_SUMMARY matches=7 mismatches=0 pending=0`, coverage of 100.00%, `UVM_ERROR : 0` and `UVM_FATAL : 0`.
